plans.note: The outline is truncated (only headings for 1.4, 5.4 surfaced), so a liability article almost certainly sits in the unlisted body under sec-p0001. Look for damages exclusions/cap language near the warranty and indemnity provisions; check mutuality and carve-outs for IP infringement, confidentiality and willful misconduct.

Search the unlisted body of the agreement for HDI indemnity covering third-party IP claims arising from the hosted site and its own negligence/misconduct; confirm any Company indemnity is limited to Deerskin Products content we supply.

No heading suggests a restrictive covenant. Still scan Article 1 scope and any covenants near the term/termination provisions for language barring the Company from operating other e-commerce sites or channels.

A site development and hosting deal for Deerskin Products commonly makes HDI the sole host or sole fulfilment channel; check Article 1 scope of services and sec-1.4 access provisions for sole-provider or 'shall not engage others' wording.

No pricing/most-favoured-customer heading is visible; if a fees article appears in the unlisted body, confirm any MFN runs in our favour and does not oblige the Company to extend its best terms to HDI.

Nothing in the outline signals a non-solicit; the most likely home would be near sec-5.4 (each party appoints a representative/personnel) or in general covenants — check for hiring restrictions on the Company and a general-advertising carve-out.

The defined term 'Termination Date' confirms a term/termination article exists in the unlisted body; verify the Company may terminate on notice without penalty and that HDI cannot terminate for convenience mid-term.
Check the same term article tied to 'Termination Date' for auto-renewal, the non-renewal notice window (target 30 days or less) and any renewal price uplift.
Boilerplate governing law/venue will sit in the final miscellaneous article just before the signature block at sec-p0072; confirm NY/DE/CA/E&W and courts rather than foreign arbitration.

Look in the closing miscellaneous provisions preceding sec-p0072 for assignment/successors language; ensure the Company may assign to affiliates and successors and HDI has no change-of-control termination right over us.

sec-1.4 (HDI providing the Company access to site materials/data) is the key hook; confirm the Company owns the site deliverables it pays for, plus customer data, order data and Deerskin marks, with no assignment of our IP to HDI.
Any licence of HDI platform/software back to the Company should appear at or near sec-1.4; check that it extends to our affiliates and contractors and is not revocable at will.

No audit heading surfaced. If an audit or records-inspection right appears near the fees/reporting or the sec-5.4 representative provisions, confirm it is limited in frequency, notified in advance and at HDI's cost.
No penalty/service-level heading is visible; scan any service-level or fees provisions in the unlisted body for liquidated damages or penalty amounts payable by the Company.

Expect HDI warranties on development and hosting performance in the unlisted body, likely adjacent to any disclaimer; check duration and that the remedy is real (re-performance plus refund/termination), not disclaimed entirely.
No insurance heading appears; given HDI hosts our site and handles customer data, confirm across the full body whether any insurance covenant exists before treating this as missing.
No volume/commitment heading surfaced; check the fees and scope articles for minimum spend, guaranteed order volumes or take-or-pay language binding the Company.

Tie to the 'Termination Date' definition and to sec-1.4 access rights; look for post-termination return of site content, customer/order data and migration assistance, and flag as missing only if the termination article is silent.
